generated_test_cases.title: Create Author Success
generated_test_cases.description: POST /api/library/authors with valid AuthorCreate payload should create a new author and return 201.
steps: Send a POST request to /api/library/authors with JSON body {"name": "John Doe"}.
Verify the response status code is 201.
expected_results: Author is created in the database.
Response status code 201 returned.

generated_test_cases.title: Create Book Security Injection
generated_test_cases.description: POST /api/library/authors/{author_id}/books with an ISBN containing SQL injection payload should not execute malicious SQL.
steps: Send a POST request to /api/library/authors/1/books with payload {"title": "Test", "isbn": "12345'; DROP TABLE books; --", "publisher_name": "Pub"}.
Verify the response status code is 201.
Check that the books table still exists and no data was corrupted.
expected_results: Book is created with the raw ISBN string.
Response status code 201 returned.
Database integrity is maintained.

generated_test_cases.title: List Books Exception Handling
generated_test_cases.description: Simulate a database connectivity failure when calling GET /api/library/books and verify proper exception handling.
steps: Mock the get_db dependency to raise a database connection exception.
Verify the API returns an appropriate error response (e.g., 500).
expected_results: API does not crash.
Returns a 500 status code indicating internal server error.

generated_test_cases.title: Verify author field is correctly set on book creation

steps: 1. Send POST /books with JSON body {"title": "Test Book", "author": "John Doe"}.
2. Receive response with status 201 and JSON containing the book details.
expected_results: 1. Status code 201 is returned.
2. The response body contains an "author" field with value "John Doe".

generated_test_cases.title: Boundary test: extremely long author name
generated_test_cases.description: Create a book with an author name at the maximum allowed length to ensure the system accepts it without truncation or errors.
steps: 1. Generate an author name string of 255 characters.
2. Send POST /books with JSON body {"title": "Test Book", "author": "<255-char-name>"}.
expected_results: 1. Status code 201 is returned.
2. The response body contains the full 255-character author name.
